summary: Master music festival and entertainment event management. Learn ISO 20121, crowd safety, and production logistics from industry experts. Enroll today.
lede: Music festival and entertainment event management brings together the planning and delivery of large-scale live events. It is designed for festival site managers, production leads, artist liaisons, safety officers and marketing directors responsible for turning plans into workable event operations. Training covers financial planning and talent-rider analysis, technical production schedules and site maps, plus crowd management, safety planning and post-event reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who have moved beyond entry-level coordination and are now responsible for the strategic and operational success of large-scale entertainment projects.
audience: Operations Managers for large-scale outdoor entertainment venues
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in event coordination or project management. Familiarity with basic financial spreadsheets and a general understanding of the live entertainment industry is required. No prior knowledge of specific safety standards like ISO 20121 is necessary, as these will be covered in depth.
